rule_audit.name: Course of conduct accepting late rent
rule_audit.citation: Finkbeiner v. Lutz, 44 Ohio App.2d 223 (1st Dist. 1975)
rule_audit.label: Course of conduct accepting late rent (Finkbeiner v. Lutz, 44 Ohio App.2d 223 (1st Dist. 1975))
rule_audit.summary: Repeated acceptance of late rent may alter the operative due date until the landlord gives advance notice ending the course of conduct.
rule_audit.source: Iskin (6th ed. 2022), § II.H; Finkbeiner v. Lutz, 44 Ohio App.2d 223, 337 N.E.2d 655 (1st Dist. 1975)
rule_audit.excerpt: , 2023, and the January 2023 rent on January 10, 2023. On March 7, 2023, Harrison tendered the March rent, which was accepted by Evergreen Properties' agent. ### Argument The doctrine established in Finkbeiner v. Lutz guides this court's analysis. Under Finkbeiner, a landlord who has accepted late rent payments without objection may not evict a tenant for a late payment unless the landlord has given effective advance notice requiring strict future compliance. elements.quote: Evergreen Properties gave no effective advance notice requiring strict future compliance, as it never communicated a change in its acceptance policy to Harrison before filing the eviction action on March 15, 2023.

rule_audit.name: Project-based HUD termination notice
rule_audit.label: Project-based HUD termination notice (24 C.F.R. § 247.4)
rule_audit.summary: A covered project-based tenancy termination notice must state the termination date, sufficiently specific reasons, the ten-day discussion right, and the right to defend in a judicial eviction; nonpayment notices have added accounting content.
rule_audit.source: 24 C.F.R. § 247.4; HUD Handbook 4350.3 REV-1 ¶ 8-13.B; Iskin (6th ed. 2022), §§ III.C-D
rule_audit.excerpt: of 145 Crestview Drive, Apt. 3B, to Plaintiff due to Defendant Jenkins's nonpayment of rent. Statement of Facts Crestview Heights Apartments is a project-based Section 8 housing project governed by 24 C.F.R. § 247.4. On February 10, 2023, Plaintiff served Defendant with a termination notice stating, 'Your tenancy will terminate on March 12, 2023.' The notice specified that 'the reason for this termination is nonpayment of rent: you owed $812.00 for February 2023, computed as of January 31, 202
